bio.text: Malvika Devi or Malvika Keshari Deo, popularly known as Rani Saa is an Indian politician from New Delhi in India. She is the wife of Arka Keshari Deo, a former Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha. She has been elected as a BJP member from Kalahandi Lok Sabha constituency in 2024 Indian general election in Odisha.
